name: computer-use-tools
description: External computer-USE consumer: exposes the `computer-use@1` capability as the action-enum tool `computer` (providers | open | screen | screenshot | act | window | wait | close), so an agent can screenshot, drive the pointer and the keyboard, read/write the clipboard and manage windows by name - driver agnostic, no display backend named

config.description: The consumer registers one tool and shapes its parameters; the DISPLAY, the runner and the tool binaries belong to the drivers' rows (computer-use-impl = the service host + the selection; computer-use-x11 = the X11 driver: target existing|xvfb, runner local|docker).
